scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run backend"
scripts.test: npm run test:run --prefix frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
